subject: wildlife-animations
label: Wildlife Lab — four-direction behavior animation pass
notes: RAHEEM APPROVED a 200-generation hard ceiling on 2026-08-07. The three reviewed 8-direction bases used 120 generations, leaving 80 for motion.

COST CORRECTION FROM THE LIVE 2026-08-07 RUN: a six-frame v3 loop cost 12 generations across four directions and an eight-frame loop cost 16. The first three fox groups used 40, bringing the base-plus-animation spend to 160. The remaining paid pass is deliberately limited to rabbit hop (12), rabbit nibble/groom at six frames (12), and tortoise toddle (12), for a planned final total of 196.

No clip is decorative duplication: movement clips are speed-scaled for ordinary roaming versus fleeing; signature clips show species-specific business; alert/rest clips cover idle and observation without snapping the animal to a different facing.

Diagonal travel uses the nearest cardinal animation while the reviewed diagonal base rotations remain available for still poses and later expansion. This keeps the first playable set coherent and inside the approved ceiling.

Rabbit alert uses its directional still with a small Phaser breathing/attention motion. Tortoise watch and tuck/glow use its directional still with restrained Phaser scale, tint, and glow motion. These are real visible animations but do not need new anatomy frames.
Do not rerun a completed entry. The harness manifest is the spend ledger and resumes around completed work.

BUDGET NOTE, Raheem 2026-08-10: the 200-generation ceiling above was scoped to getting the first three animals into the game and is CLOSED at 196. Drinking is a new subject with its own budget. Flow agreed: fox complete -> test -> rabbit complete -> test -> fish -> tortoise last. One animal all the way through before the next one starts.
